notes.title: Bugfixes and improvements - July the 1st - 2025
notes.content:
Steam Notifications
Never miss your turn again! This major update introduces Steam notifications that will alert you instantly when it's your turn to play, when opponents make their moves, and for other important game events. Whether you're browsing other games or away from your computer, you'll always know when the action is waiting for you.

What's New:

    Steam Login Integration: Seamlessly connect your Steam account to receive real-time notifications

    Turn-Based Alerts: Get notified the moment it's your turn - no more checking back constantly

Enhanced Gameplay Experience:

    Clearer Rules: Added detailed explanations of player status to help new and veteran players alike

    Enhanced UI for Fights: Ships protected by shields are now grayed out when you attempt shots that are too weak, preventing wasted moves and confusion

    Improved Information Display: Fixed issues where inactive technologies weren't showing their details properly

notes.title: Update notes for 09.04.25
notes.content:
Changes:
- Remember influence highlight
- Visualization of additional colony ships
Fixes:
- Hangup when purchasing Ancient Labs Technology
- Game crashes if the warp portal had to be placed on the home sector
- Notifications on mobile devices
- Tutorial incorrect display for Pass/End Turn
- Incorrect positioning of the action bar at the start of an online game.
- When pressing the back button, a different discovery was displayed

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements for 2nd Dawn
notes.content:
Unfortunately, the update will make the current games unplayable. Please finish the games by then or wait to update until you have finished your games.

Fixed the following problems:

- AI chooses a warp portal deployment, even if there is already a warp portal in the sector.
- Diplomacy through Warpportal not possible.
- Draco can be peacefully on a sector with Guardians.
- There is one 2 victory point reward piece too few in the game
- 2 Monolith and 1 Orbital Discovery too many in play
- The GCDS only has +1 instead of +2 computers
- 6 does not apply to ships with shields
- It is not possible to influence sectors from captured ships.
- Orbital Discovery is missing 2 material for the player
- Game sometimes crashes towards the end. (Could occur if a player's influence bar was completely empty, or completely full in the digital version).
- Warpportal Discovery by Ancient Labs are not placed on the player's starting sector.
- Discovery with 3 money, 2 science and 2 material is missing.
- Warpportals are not optional.
- Game crashes if you choose a population marker on an expanded universal planet for which you have not researched the technology.
- Alternate blueprints are now available.
